physics: Open phi4 chain, all onsite potentials even; site-dependent quadratic/quartic coefficients and bond strengths preserve global parity.
reference: Direct variational spectra in nested onsite eigenbases at increasing retained dimensions; independent oscillator frequency/Fock check; one full-Fock tensor-product cross-check. No extrapolated labels.
control: Builder-written generic matrix-free extension of the onsite-basis method, including all physical arrays. Literal v1 unsupported-length errors do not count as scientific failures.
limitations: Three-case pilot only, not a balanced benchmark or a hardness claim. Passing a small pilot does not establish 72-case budget achievability; failing the 16-state control does not exclude smaller-basis or MPS methods.
